title: Hypothesis: legal adult-fiction translation fidelity varies materially across local and hosted models
summary: Documented ebook translators do not establish omission/refusal rates on lawful adult fiction, or guarantee no tonal modification. Requires independent permissioned benchmarks; never infer from model name.
